market_question: Will Bitcoin dip to $75,000 in May?
reasoning: Bitcoin at ~$84k, a 10.7% drop to $75k in a month is plausible but not more likely than not. Assuming ~3% daily volatility and neutral drift, the first-passage probability for hitting $75k is around 50%. The market’s 57.5% slightly overestimates the likelihood, giving a negative edge on Yes.
evidence_points: Bitcoin spot price ~$84,000 (Binance BTC/USDT), $75k is ~10.7% below current.
30-day annualized volatility ~65%, translating to ~16% monthly standard deviation in log-prices.
Driftless barrier-hit probability over 30 days ≈ 2*Φ(−ln(84/75)/0.164) = 48-50%, and bullish drift biases it lower.
Recent intra-month drawdowns have been 15-20% but typically reverse; this May holds no obvious high-conviction catalyst for a break.
sources_consulted: Custom estimate of monthly volatility from daily returns (CoinGecko/Binance)
Black-Scholes / first-passage barrier approximation for GBM
